title: Bowerbird · Private image organizer for Mac, Windows and Linux
excerpt: Bowerbird is a private, local-first desktop app for browsing, tagging and rating the images already on your computer. No account, no cloud. Pay once.

Browse, tag and rate your images, privately and offline

Local-first desktop app.
No account. No cloud.

Bowerbird is a desktop app for browsing, tagging and rating the images you already have.

Point it at a folder and it shows everything inside, subfolders included.

Your private files stay exactly where they are.

Add a folder. See everything. Sort through it.

1

Add a folder

Pick any folder on your computer or an external drive. Bowerbird reads it where it is.

2

See every image

Everything inside, subfolders included, shows in one grid, each image at its own shape and never cropped.

3

Tag and Rate

Give images tags and stars as you go, then find them again with search, filters and smart folders.

Built for going through a lot of images quickly

  • Ratings

    Press 1 to 5 to rate the selected images, and 0 to clear. Select a whole shoot and rate it in one go.

  • Tags

    Colored tags you type to find, or create on the spot. Add them to a whole selection at once.

  • Search and filters

    Search file names, folders and tags, then narrow it down by tag, file type, orientation or rating.

  • Smart folders

    Save any search as a smart folder. Open it later and the search comes back, ready to change and save again.

  • Untagged and Unrated

    Two views of everything you haven't sorted yet. Work through them, and images leave as you rate or tag them.

  • Fast on big folders

    Thumbnails are made in the background, the ones on screen first, so scrolling stays quick. HEIC works too, on macOS and Windows.

  • Libraries

    Keep work and personal apart. Each library has its own folders, tags, ratings and smart folders.

  • Light or dark

    Pick a theme, or let Bowerbird follow your system.

  • Your files stay put

    Bowerbird never moves, renames, copies or deletes your images. Ratings and tags live in its own library.

  • Survives renames

    Ratings and tags belong to the image, not its path, so they follow it when you move or rename it.

  • Stays on your computer

    No account, no cloud, no analytics. The app only goes online to activate your license and check for updates; your images and library never leave your computer.

  • Every feature, with no limits on images or libraries
  • Use it on two computers
  • Free updates, for life

Buy Bowerbird or download the free trial

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Bowerbird connect to the internet?Offline
Only to activate your license and to check for updates. Apart from that, your images, ratings and tags never leave your computer. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

Which file types does it open? Universal
JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF and HEIC/HEIF. HEIC and TIFF previews use your system's own thumbnailer, so they show on Mac and Windows; on Linux, those files are listed by name.

Will it change my files? Read-only
No. Your images are never moved, renamed, copied or written to. Bowerbird only reads them.

What happens if I remove a folder?Recoverable
Remove a folder and add it back later: its ratings and tags come back with it.

Where are my ratings and tags kept?Local
Ratings, tags and smart folders live in Bowerbird's own database, library.db, on your computer. Nothing is written into your files.

Where do the thumbnails go?Performant
Thumbnails are made on your computer and kept in Bowerbird's own folder, never next to your photos.

Does Bowerbird use AI?No AI
No. Your images are never sent to an AI service, and never used to train one. If Bowerbird ever adds AI features, they'll run entirely on your computer, and stay off until you turn them on.

What happens when the trial ends?Free to start
Bowerbird asks for a license before it opens again. Your images stay in your folders, untouched, and your ratings, tags and smart folders are kept: they're all there as soon as you enter a key.

Where do the thumbnails go?Performant Thumbnails are made on your computer and kept in Bowerbird's own folder, never next to your photos.

Does Bowerbird use AI?No AI No. Your images are never sent to an AI service, and never used to train one. If Bowerbird ever adds AI features, they'll run entirely on your computer, and stay off until you turn them on.

What happens when the trial ends?Free to start Bowerbird asks for a license before it opens again. Your images stay in your folders, untouched, and your ratings, tags and smart folders are kept: they're all there as soon as you enter a key.
